Hyper-IgE syndrome (Job syndrome) with superimposed opportunistic infections

response.rationale: Autopsy confirms both disseminated aspergillosis and candidiasis, and the eye findings (eosinophilic infiltrate with larval sections) indicate a parasitic infection, making D1 the most complete diagnosis. D2 and D3 each miss one of the confirmed fungal infections, D4 ignores the systemic fungal infections, and D5 is a predisposing condition rather than the acute cause of death.
